manifest: shared parameter manifest for roadmap items B and E

authority: Values marked source=code are the convention IN FORCE, recovered from the committed sources and cross-checked by tests/test_manifest_BE.py. Values marked source=proposed appear in no committed script or output and are card proposals only.

stacks.note: The repository runs three disjoint time conventions, not one. The manifest keeps them separate; conflating them is the single most likely way B and E silently diverge.
stacks.shot: Sequential detection and policies. Dimensionless tau_c/c in cycles; no absolute c. Used by B.
stacks.physical: tau-optimised map. c = tau + t_dead with t_dead = 1 as the unit of time. Used by C08.
stacks.identifiability: sid_run7. Prices NO dead time: td = 1.0 is assigned at sid_run7.py:20 and never used in any equation. Its axis is tau_c/T2. Used by E.
stacks.D1_convention_split: B uses effective per-shot contrast C_eff, which INCLUDES all loss at its implicit fixed interrogation. E uses zero-dephasing contrast C_0, with exp(-chi(tau)) applied separately. These are not one physical operating point and do not share a C_bar field. No key named 'C_bar' appears anywhere in this manifest.

operating_point_second.label: UPPER-BOUND STRESS TEST at the parity ceiling. Not a realistic contrast.
operating_point_second.why: C_eff = 0.5 is exactly the parity ceiling C_par = (1/2) C_1 C_2 <= 1/2 (cards/v1.1-frozen.md:117), so it stays inside the oscillator-cancelled parity regime that cards/v2.0-seed.md:11 makes the home of the principal claims. The previously proposed 0.8 would have put a freeze gate in the servo regime and made it depend on roadmap D.
operating_point_second.validity: Against C23's level delta(0) = 0.3, ONE of the three grid points (tau_c/c = 20) is outside the validity of the slope-resummed weak-correlation rate, against two of three under the withdrawn 0.8 proposal (0.0613/0.4757/2.0544). Interpretation at tau_c/c = 5 and 20 uses the EXACT comparator; neither the strict O(s^4) asymptote nor the slope-resummed rate is valid there.

action_set.note: theta only; tau is NOT an action. p0(pi/2) = 0.5 exactly for any contrast; p0(pi) = (1 - C_eff)/2, which is 0.30 at the pilot (C_eff = 0.4) and 0.25 at the adopted second point (C_eff = 0.5). Corrected 7 Sept 2026: this note previously quoted 0.10 at the withdrawn C_bar = 0.8 proposal.

false_alarm_target_secondary.note: h = ln(gamma), set analytically; live in sid_core/sid_run5, NOT the policy stack

calibration.method: fixed-iteration bisection on h, no convergence test
calibration.h_star_lattice: h* in {1 + 5k/64 : k odd, 1 <= k <= 63}; adjacent reachable values differ by 5/32 = 0.15625

bank.prior: discretised stationary N(0, s^2), renormalised on the grid
bank.why: g, prior and T all depend on s; e1 depends on C and s. Every Bank is operating-point dependent.

hedges.conflict: cards/v2.0-seed.md:20 and ledgers/roadmap.yaml say three hedges; four are calibrated and measured. note-03a-errata E2 names three schedule FAMILIES (interleave B=1, B=10, explore-then-switch), which reconciles the count only if switch@300 and switch@1000 are one family.

benchmark.definition: bench(T) = min(delay[oracle-mid(tc=T)], delay[extremum-only]) at each true tau_c

acceptance.note: sid_fig_policy_delays.py:50 hard-codes _target, _tol = 3.0e4, 0.30 and only WARNS; it is not a gate and it passes rows whose true ARLs are +49% and +58% off.

operating_point_servo_appendix.must_not: may not gate the principal parity result
operating_point_servo_appendix.provenance_warning: 0.8 is not a computed value: it is a rounded reading of note 03 section 5, nearest computed entries 0.8126 and 0.8073 in res7B_servo.json under claim C14, status pilot.

t_dead.warning: c = tau + t_dead is defined ONLY in code (sid_core.py:331, sid_run3.py:129, sid_run4.py:59). The frozen card never defines it.

u.consequence: rho_1 = F(u) * exp(-c/tau_c), so the AR(1) reduction is exact only as tau/tau_c -> 0 (short interrogation relative to the correlation time), NOT as c/tau_c -> 0.

eta_0.decision: D3: all three retained. An already archived, useful dimension is not discarded; the card is updated to match.

dimensionless_target.ratio_2: Delta_Gamma_phi / (2 eta_0 Gamma_hat), stored as res7A column 8, range 0.0625 ... 31.25
dimensionless_target.note: Both ratios are ALREADY computable from committed code. Item E's dimensionless restatement needs no new machinery, which is why it runs first.

admissible_classes.A: |chi(tau) - chi_hat(tau)| <= eta_0 * chi_hat(tau) for all tau in T (pointwise band)

determinism.wording: seed-free and reproducible within 6e-8, but optimizer- and stack-dependent
determinism.requirement: store optimizer termination status and all three starts alongside the infimum

C_0.note: C_0 = 0.5 is the second PRINCIPAL-REGIME slice. The existing C_0 = 0.9 rows are retained as servo/coherent context and MUST NOT be used to support the parity-regime headline.

decisions_resolved.decision: Split the convention. B uses C_eff (all loss included at its implicit fixed interrogation); E uses C_0 with exp(-chi(tau)) applied separately. No shared ambiguous C_bar field.

B's second point is C_eff = 0.5, s = 0.3 -- the parity ceiling, labelled an upper-bound stress test, not a realistic contrast. C_eff ~ 0.8 is retained only as an optional servo-appendix run after roadmap D, and may not gate the principal parity result. D is NOT promoted to a freeze gate.
Keep all three calibration uncertainties eta_0 in {0.02, 0.05, 0.10}; update the card to match.

terminology.rule: The two mid-fringe formulas are NEVER both called 'leading order'. That is the ambiguity the 7 Sept 2026 split removed, and the single word would recreate it.
terminology.strict O(s^4) asymptote: I_mid_strict = 1/2 C^4 s^4 Sum a_k^2. Function I_mid_strict. Uniformly 63-64 percent high against the exact half-sum at s = 0.5; not a usable approximation there.
terminology.slope-resummed weak-correlation rate: I_mid_slope = I_mid_strict * e^{-2 s^2}. Function I_mid_slope. The card's form; within 1 percent of the exact half-sum over tau_c/c in [1, 100] at s = 0.5.
terminology.applies_to: manuscript, cards, ledger statements, notes, docstrings and figure legends
